ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND(AllowChange__c = false, ISCHANGED( Commitment_Amount_nearest__c ), Has_Child__c =false), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The commitment amount cannot be edited because it was created as a result of a transfer from a commitment. Please delete the transfer that created this commitment, which would delete the commitment too; then create a new transfer with the correct amount.
